import openpyxl

status_col = headers.index("Status")

target_deals = {"D001", "D003", "D006"}
filtered_rows = []

    rep = str(row_list[rep_col]).strip()
    status = str(row_list[status_col]).strip()
    if deal_id in target_deals and rep == "James Okafor" and status == "Won":

print(f"Filtered {len(filtered_rows)} rows")
for r in filtered_rows:

header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
